role: Composition root: the only file (with EmuquApp/WatchApp) allowed to read `Type.shared`. AppDependencies exposes eight lazily-built service groups whose accessors return a test substitute from a lock-guarded Overrides box or the live singleton; also defines the SwiftUI `\.dependencies` environment key and the shared Overpass client.
types: AppDependencies: struct — container: overrides box + 8 group accessors + static `current`
AppDependencies.Overrides: final class — OSAllocatedUnfairLock<Values> holding 67 optional substitutes
UtilityServices / AnalysisServices / AssistantServices / CollectionServices / LocationServices / ProviderServices / AppServices / StorageServices: struct — per-layer accessors (substitute ?? .shared)
OverpassServices: private enum — one OverpassClient shared by RoadGraphService and TrailDiscoveryService
DependenciesKey: private struct EnvironmentKey — computed defaultValue returning AppDependencies.current at each read
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: `let overrides = Overrides()` (27); static storage lock seeded with AppDependencies() (51); Overrides.values lock seeded with an all-nil Values (127); OverpassServices builds OverpassClient() and the two Overpass services lazily on first static access (625-627).

flags.text: The whole Overrides substitution layer (67 lock-guarded slots, the `current` setter and reset()) is never exercised: no code in Emuqu, EmuquTests or EmuquUITests assigns any `overrides.<name>`, sets `AppDependencies.current`, or calls `reset()`. Every group accessor's `if let substitute` branch is therefore never taken and the container is only an indirection over `.shared`.

The container is reached as the global `AppDependencies.current` from ~518 sites (static helpers, services, fact resolvers) rather than injected, so the services still form a hidden global graph; the composition-root rule only moved the `.shared` reads here.

units.does: Getter returns a copy of the process-wide container from the OSAllocatedUnfairLock (copy shares the same Overrides box); setter replaces the stored container. The getter is read by ~518 `AppDependencies.current` call sites in production; the setter has no caller in the repo.

flags.text: The setter documented for tests (lines 17-18, 39-40) is never used: grep for 'AppDependencies.current *=' over all Swift including EmuquTests returns nothing, so the substitution mechanism is untested scaffolding.

The documented test-substitution path cannot work for most services: every Overrides slot is typed as the concrete final class (no protocol), and most of those classes have a private init, so no substitute instance can be built outside the type (e.g. SettingsManager, StoreKitManager, EncryptionManager, CloudKitSyncManager, FeatureFlags). Combined with zero callers of the `current` setter, overrides setters or reset(), the container's test seam is unused and largely unusable.

docs/MAINTAINERS.md repeats that 'a test makes a fresh container, sets the substitute on its overrides, assigns it to current in setUp, and calls reset() in tearDown'; no test in EmuquTests does any of these (the only direct container use is AppDependencies().location in OverpassClientTests).

units.does: Replaces the process-wide container with a fresh AppDependencies() (new, empty Overrides box).

flags.text: reset() has no caller anywhere (production or tests): grep 'AppDependencies.reset' finds only its declaration and the doc comment at line 18.

units.does: EnvironmentKey default for \.dependencies: a computed static that returns AppDependencies.current at each read (not a one-time snapshot), so a container swapped into `current` reaches views that have no injected value.
units.entry: SwiftUI reads it whenever a view's environment has no \.dependencies value (always, since nothing injects one).

units.does: SwiftUI EnvironmentValues accessor for the container: get returns self[DependenciesKey] (defaulting to DependenciesKey.defaultValue, i.e. AppDependencies.current at the time of the read), set stores an override for a subtree.
units.entry: Read by @Environment(\.dependencies) in views (e.g. Emuqu/Sources/Views/SettingsView.swift:12); the setter is only used if a view applies .environment(\.dependencies, ...), which no code in the repo does.
